ideas.title: Representation-first mathematical objects
ideas.claim: A mathematical object can be exposed through multiple typed representations linked by explicit maps and invariants.
assumptions: Each representation has declared semantics and scope.
provenance: Merlin discussions: coordinate systems and geometric transforms
objections: Not all representations are lossless or mutually convertible.
next_steps: Specify typed representation interface and commuting-diagram checker.

ideas.title: Simultaneous coordinate frames
ideas.claim: One geometric object may have multiple coordinate descriptions connected by transition maps.
assumptions: Frames, units, domains and singularities are explicit.
provenance: Merlin discussions: one point in 2D/3D/4D/5D+ systems
objections: Coordinate singularity must not be confused with geometric singularity.
next_steps: Build typed transition-map registry and path-consistency tests.

ideas.title: Complex and trigonometric representation bridge
ideas.claim: Complex polar form, Euler identity and planar rotations provide linked representations of 2D rotations.
assumptions: Angle convention and orientation are fixed.
provenance: Merlin discussions: cos x, sin y, i and polar coordinates
objections: Conventions and branch choices matter.
next_steps: Prove matrix/complex rotation correspondence in Lean.

ideas.title: Geometric number systems
ideas.claim: Complex numbers, quaternions, dual numbers and Clifford/geometric algebras can be compared by their algebraic laws and geometric semantics.
assumptions: Each algebra is specified independently; no blanket interchangeability.
provenance: Merlin discussions: geometric numbers and alien glyph mathematics
objections: Different algebras have different multiplication and geometric properties.
next_steps: Create algebra capability matrix and typed homomorphism catalog.

ideas.title: Eigenstructure and higher-dimensional transforms
ideas.claim: Spectral and invariant-subspace descriptions can be compared across matrix representations when basis and operator semantics are explicit.
assumptions: Underlying operator and field are declared.
provenance: Merlin discussions: eigenvalues and 3D/4D/5D number systems
objections: Matrix eigenvalues depend on the represented operator; basis changes and field matter.
next_steps: Implement basis-aware operator identity and spectral test suite.

ideas.title: Spacetime projections and periodic time structure
ideas.claim: Spacetime trajectories, observer frames, time slices and periodic dynamics can be represented with explicit projection and information-loss semantics.
assumptions: Physical claims require a specified model and observable.
provenance: Merlin discussions: block spacetime, projections and time crystals
objections: Time-crystal definitions differ between equilibrium and driven settings.
next_steps: Specify model classes and observable-level falsifiable tests.

ideas.title: Glyph-native typed mathematical language
ideas.claim: A glyph can denote a typed operation with a canonical AST identity; its visual glyph is a rendering, not semantic authority.
assumptions: Glyph IDs and semantics are versioned.
provenance: XMG-1 Glyph Foundry and normalizer implementation
objections: Current language and operators are limited; not a general discovery system.
next_steps: Extend operator signatures, symbolic patterns and proof export.

ideas.title: XMG termination and confluence
ideas.claim: A terminating typed rewrite system with locally joinable critical pairs is confluent; current implementation explores a bounded subset.
assumptions: Every rewrite strictly decreases a well-founded measure; local confluence covers all overlaps.
provenance: XMG-1C normalizer; XMG-1D Lean source; XMG-1E explorer
objections: Finite expression probes do not establish global confluence; Lean compilation remains to be confirmed.
next_steps: Compile Lean root; formalize AST size, typing and rule decrease; generate symbolic critical pairs.

ideas.title: Ideonomy as a typed idea hypergraph
ideas.claim: Mathematical ideas and multi-way relations can be represented as a typed hypergraph with explicit epistemic status.
assumptions: Missing catalog entries are not evidence of novelty.
provenance: Merlin discussions: ideonomy and idea-space enumeration
objections: Null-model scores require calibration and multiple-testing controls.
next_steps: Implement idea graph, duplicate detection and provenance validation.

ideas.title: Mathematical idea intake and evidence ledger
ideas.claim: Stable idea IDs, controlled status vocabulary and typed relations make research accumulation auditable.
assumptions: Repository intake protocol is followed by agents and contributors.
objections: Conversation-to-repository capture still requires an authorized workflow.
next_steps: Add schema validator and CI integration.

ideas.title: Lacunarity and multiscale morphology
ideas.claim: Lacunarity describes scale-dependent mass heterogeneity and can distinguish structures with similar fractal dimension.
assumptions: Mean window mass is positive; sampling metadata is recorded.
provenance: Allain & Cloitre 1991 DOI 10.1103/PhysRevA.44.3552; Merlin fractal engineering discussions
objections: Not a universal engineering quality score.
next_steps: Build reproducible multiscale lacunarity benchmark with matched baselines.

ideas.title: Mathematical-to-CAD/MCFC engineering bridge
ideas.claim: CAD and wiring artifacts can be represented as typed geometry, frames, connectivity, physical fields, constraints and evidence.
assumptions: Simulation is conditional on model assumptions and requires independent validation.
objections: A rendered diagram is not a verified physical design.
next_steps: Define typed assembly and wiring schema; connect simulation receipts.

ideas.title: Superorganism and collective mathematics
ideas.claim: Collective systems can be modeled through interacting agents, network dynamics and multiscale observables.
assumptions: Specify causal and measurement assumptions.
objections: Analogy alone does not establish a shared mathematical mechanism.
next_steps: Choose a concrete model class and derive falsifiable predictions.

ideas.title: XMG-1E deterministic confluence benchmark
ideas.claim: The benchmark includes a deliberately divergent positive control and a bounded default-rule probe.
assumptions: Only the recorded expressions and rule set are tested.
objections: Prior run failed import resolution; path fix committed but rerun not yet confirmed.
next_steps: Rerun benchmark on Avrea and preserve JSON artifact with source revision.

ideas.title: Null-model anomaly scoring for idea-space gaps
ideas.claim: A calibrated null model may help identify structurally unusual regions of an idea graph.
assumptions: Null constraints, seed, sample size and correction method are declared.
objections: Zero variance is not calibrated; anomaly does not imply novelty or truth.
next_steps: Specify null models and calibration experiments before using scores.

ideas.title: Exact multi-frame transition graph
ideas.claim: For a fixed two-dimensional vector space and invertible rational frame maps P_i, coordinate transitions T_i_to_j = P_j P_i^{-1} compose path-independently and closed frame cycles are identity.
assumptions: All frames describe the same vector space over the same field.
All frame maps are invertible and share the declared canonical reference.
provenance: Avrea workflow run 41888107492 passed the 2D prototype, catalog validator and Python compile at commit d7664972db5c032b439c901e00d68c9f6ad8ba03.
Avrea run 41888718729 passed catalog validation, representation graph tests including the 5D case, and Python compile at the recorded PR-head snapshot.
objections: The Avrea receipt applies to the 2D implementation at the recorded commit; the later n-dimensional extension has not yet been rerun on Avrea.
This does not prove consistency of arbitrary independently supplied graph edges or connection holonomy.
next_steps: Qualify the later n-dimensional extension on Avrea.
Add partial coordinate charts and explicit domains.
Formalize transition composition in Lean.

ideas.title: Spectral invariants under basis change
ideas.claim: If A_i = P_i A P_i^{-1} for an invertible basis-change matrix over a fixed field, then A_i is similar to A and has the same characteristic polynomial, trace, determinant and eigenvalue multiset with algebraic multiplicity.
assumptions: Finite-dimensional vector space.
P_i is invertible.
The scalar field is held fixed.
provenance: Avrea run 41888718729 passed catalog validation, representation graph tests including the 5D case, and Python compile at the recorded PR-head snapshot.
objections: The real-versus-complex scalar field distinction changes which eigenvalues and eigenvectors are visible.
Current prototype tests trace and determinant invariance in dimensions 2 and 5; full characteristic-polynomial identity is not yet implemented.
The current Avrea run checked trace/determinant invariance only in 2D; the later 5D test source has not yet been qualified.
next_steps: Add exact characteristic-polynomial calculation.
Prove similarity invariance in Lean for finite matrices.

ideas.title: Coordinate cocycles versus connection holonomy
ideas.claim: Merlin must distinguish overlap-consistent coordinate transition maps from parallel transport defined by a connection; non-identity products of arbitrary graph edges alone do not establish curvature.
assumptions: Domains and overlap maps are explicitly recorded.
Connection transport is separately defined along paths.
provenance: Merlin discussions of multiple frames and spacetime geometry
objections: A graph-cycle discrepancy may be inconsistent edge data, not geometric holonomy.
Nontrivial holonomy requires a specified connection and path transport.
next_steps: Implement connection-aware path transport on a small manifold example.
Compare coordinate overlap cocycles with curvature-derived holonomy.

ideas.title: Audit of proposed Clifford embeddings and quadric intersections
ideas.claim: Archived PGA/CGA/QGA embedding, projection and exact quadric-intersection claims require explicit signature-preserving algebra homomorphisms and an algebraic-geometric intersection construction; outer product alone is not a general intersection-ideal operation.
assumptions: Each algebra uses a declared basis and metric convention.
Every generator relation must be preserved by an embedding.
objections: The archived text conflates basis labels, metric relations and geometric interpretations.
The outer product of blades is not, in general, the ideal-theoretic intersection of arbitrary quadric zero sets.
next_steps: Construct explicit low-dimensional counterexamples.
Derive candidate embeddings from the Clifford algebra universal property.
Define quadrics as polynomial ideals or verified equivalent representations.

ideas.title: Integral criterion for finite-time blow-up
ideas.claim: For a positive scalar autonomous ODE dI/dt = f(I)I, finite-time escape to infinity is governed by convergence of the separation integral from I0 to infinity, not merely by f(I) being bounded below by a positive constant.
assumptions: f is sufficiently regular and positive on [I0,infinity).
A local solution exists and remains in the stated domain.
The maximal-solution and escape-time argument is supplied.
objections: The archived lower-bound condition f(I)>=1 only yields at least exponential growth and does not imply finite-time blow-up.
A rigorous Lean statement must quantify a solution trajectory and non-vacuous maximal time.
next_steps: Formalize the integral criterion for a concrete power-law family.
Replace the vacuous archived theorem statement with an ODE solution theorem.

ideas.title: Audit of archived Parrondo capability demonstration
ideas.claim: The archived Python example does not demonstrate two individually losing operators producing net gain under alternation because operator A is assigned a positive capability increment.
assumptions: The code's delta_I is interpreted as its deterministic per-step capability change.
The resource subtraction convention is retained.
objections: A corrected stochastic Parrondo model may still be possible but is a separate experiment.
next_steps: Define stochastic state transitions and a common initial distribution.
Compare A-alone, B-alone and switching policies with paired seeds and identical budgets.

ideas.title: N-dimensional exact frame graph
ideas.claim: The transition-graph construction extends to arbitrary finite dimension n when each frame is represented by an invertible n×n matrix over a common field.
assumptions: All frames have equal dimension and describe the same vector space.
The common scalar field and exact or approximate arithmetic model are declared.
provenance: Avrea run 41888718729 passed catalog validation, representation graph tests including the 5D case, and Python compile at the recorded PR-head snapshot.
objections: The current implementation is limited to exact rational matrices.
Partial charts, affine transforms, tensors and nonlinear maps are not implemented.
The added 5D test has not yet been confirmed by a current Avrea run.
next_steps: Run the expanded tests on Avrea.
Add 3D, 4D and 5D examples and random invertible matrices with reproducible seeds.
Formalize arbitrary finite-dimensional composition in Lean.

ideas.title: Complex, quaternion, matrix and rotor views of 3D rotations
ideas.claim: A 3D rotation about a fixed axis can be represented as a real rotation matrix, a complex multiplication on the orthogonal plane, a unit-quaternion sandwich action, and a geometric-algebra rotor action, with explicit convention-preserving maps.
assumptions: Rotation axis is unit length.
Quaternion and rotor multiplication conventions are fixed.
The same active/passive and handedness conventions are used across representations.
provenance: Merlin discussions: sin/cos, i, polar coordinates, quaternions and geometric numbers
MERLIN mathematical idea ledger sections 3 and 4
objections: Quaternion q and -q encode the same spatial rotation; the representation is a double cover, not one-to-one.
The complex-plane representation covers the plane perpendicular to the rotation axis, not all of 3D as a single complex coordinate.
Rotor sign and orientation conventions must be reconciled explicitly.
next_steps: Derive the quaternion-to-matrix formula and verify it symbolically.
Prove equivalence of quaternion sandwich action and Cl(3,0) rotor action under a declared basis map.
Test exact 180-degree rotations and approximate 90-degree rotations with error bounds.
